research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Europe-led kidswear trade fairs; premium and mid-market childrenswear, newborn to teen
title: SS27 Kids' Category Opportunities
summary: Growth categories for SS27 kidswear: UV-protective swim and tees, organic basics and sleepwear, denim, coordinated sets, baby shoes and family capsules.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- **UV protection:** swimwear, tees and accessories with UV filters becoming common<sup>[1]</sup>.
- **Organic and certified basics:** recycled fibres, organic cotton and certified materials<sup>[1]</sup>.
- **Shoes:** Pisamonas showed strap ballerinas, leather sandals, barefoot models and first-summer baby shoes<sup>[2]</sup>.
- **Sleepwear:** organic cotton pyjamas at Cadhan<sup>[2]</sup>, pyjamas in MilK's selection<sup>[3]</sup>.
- **Denim:** stronger and more diverse at Playtime Paris<sup>[4]</sup>.
- **Family dressing:** adult and child pieces, including mother-daughter matches, at Marie Raxevisky<sup>[2]</sup>.
- **Buyers want difference:** Smallable comes to Pitti Bimbo to find niche brands<sup>[5]</sup>.

sections.heading: Opportunities
sections.body:
1. UPF swim and sun-protective tees and hats.
2. Organic basics and pyjamas.
3. Denim dungarees, jackets and shorts.
4. Coordinated sets.
5. Baby and first-walker shoes.
6. Family and mini-me capsules.

sections.heading: Baby and toddler
sections.body: Brands at Pitti Bimbo cover newborn upwards (Cozmo from newborn to 14 years<sup>[2]</sup>). For baby and toddler, prioritise soft organic cotton, easy fastenings, first shoes and sleepwear. Forecut did not find separate SS27 evidence for toddler boys and toddler girls, so those pages are not yet published.

design_implications:
- Re-weight development toward function and durability.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist of young children's clothing, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, beads, shells and other decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Re-weight open-to-buy toward swim, basics and denim.
